M0527001 COMMENT: The cross sections of (g,n) reactions were measured
 for ground and isomeric states 1h-11/2 in 16 isotopes
 of Pd, Cd, Sn, Te, Ba, Ce, Nd, and Sm. The energy of
 g-rays was placed in the region of the giant dipole
 resonance. An activation method of measurement has
 been used. The cross section dependence on the
 neutron and proton number in nucleus was obtained and
 on the excitation energy of the residual nucleus as
 well. Different factors influencing the values of the
 isomeric ratios are discussed.

M0629001 COMMENT: The isomeric ratios (IR) were measured in the isotones
 with N = 81 (135Xe,  137Ba, 139Ce, 141Nd, and 143Sm).
 Isomers with   J-PI  =  11/2-  were  excited  in  the
 reactions (n,g),  (g,n),  and b+ - decay of 139Pr and
 141Pm. The    activation    methods   of   g-spectrum
 measurement was used. The marked difference of Ir was
 observed in  the  isotones  with the different atomic
 numbers Z but in the same reactions. The calculations
 of Ir   using   low-level   spectrum   and  radiation
 transitions on the base of the  quasiparticle  phonon
 model were  performed.  The satisfactory agreement of
 the measured and calculated Ir was obtained  for  all
 studied isotopes.  The  dependence  of  Ir  on  Z  is
 explained by the different  energy  of  reaction  and
 different probability   levels   population   of  the
 activation.; PRIMARY_PAPER_RESOLUTION: M/G activation production-yield ratio; Eq.5 p.1904 explicitly ratio of spectrum-integrated yields with state-specific thresholds. M0679001 COMMENT: The isomeric  ratios  in  the reactions (gamma,n) and
 (n,2n) leading to the production of odd-odd nuclides
 184Re, 190Ir, and 196Au  presented. The measurements
 were performed   by   activation   method   at   the
 irradiation of  natural  Re,  Ir,  and Au samples by
 14.7 MeV  neutrons  and  by  Bremsstrahlung  with  a
 end-point energy  of  22 MeV.  Identification of the
 obtained nuclei in isomeric and  ground  states  was
 made basing on their spectra of X or g radiation and
 the half-life.  A calculation of isomeric ratios was
 performed on the basis of statistical model, and the
 parameters describing the dependence  of  the  level
 density on   the   excitation   energy  and  angular
 momentum were  determined  from  the  comparison  of
 experimental and calculated values. The influence of
 the nuclear  structure  on   these   parameters   is
 discussed.; PRIMARY_PAPER_RESOLUTION: Photon IR=Ym/Yg, primary Eq.3 spectrum-integrated production yields; neutron Eq.2 cross-section equality is a different irradiation. ir_uncertainty_raw: M1034010 ERR-ANALYS: No uncertainties given.
cross_section_type_raw:
,SIG/RAT,,BRA,DERIV
M1034010 ANALYSIS: The direct measurement of ICR (isomeric cross section
 ratio) for 186m,gRe isomeric pairs is impossible due
 to the long half-life of the 186mRe isomeric state
 (2.0 x 10**5 y). The half-life of the 186gRe ground
 state is short (3.72 d), therefore the experimental
 average cross section measurement is possible.
 In order to evaluate the ICR for 186m,gRe isomeric
 semi-empirical method was used which consits of the
 combination of theoretical and experimental data. In
 order to obtain the theoretically calculated cross
 section for the formation of 186Re, the TALYS 1.9 and
 EMPIRE 3.2 nuclear codes were applied.
The theoretically calculated cross section for the
formation of 186Re obtained using the TALYS 1.9
nuclear code.
